```gherkin
Feature: User Authentication and System Administration

  Scenario: Valid User Login
    Given a valid username and password
    When the user attempts to log in
    Then the user is granted access to the System

  Scenario: Invalid User Login
    Given an invalid username and password
    When the user attempts to log in
    Then the user is denied access to the System

  Scenario: Administrator Login
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to log in
    Then the administrator is granted access to the System Administrator Screens

  Scenario: User Creation
    Given a valid username and password
    When the administrator creates a new user
    Then the new user is added to the System

  Scenario: Speciality Maintenance
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to add a new speciality
    Then the speciality is added to the System

  Scenario: Speciality Editing
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to edit an existing speciality
    Then the speciality is updated in the System

  Scenario Outline: Speciality Validation
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to add a new speciality with the following details
      | Speciality ID | Speciality Name | Speciality Description |
      | <speciality_id> | <speciality_name> | <speciality_description> |
    Then the speciality is added to the System with the specified details

  Examples:
    | speciality_id | speciality_name | speciality_description |
    | 1             | Cardiology      | Heart-related issues   |
    | 2             | Neurology       | Brain-related issues   |
    | 3             | Invalid ID      | Invalid description    |

  Scenario Outline: Speciality Editing Validation
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to edit an existing speciality with the following details
      | Speciality ID | Speciality Name | Speciality Description |
      | <speciality_id> | <speciality_name> | <speciality_description> |
    Then the speciality is updated in the System with the specified details

  Examples:
    | speciality_id | speciality_name | speciality_description |
    | 1             | Cardiology      | Heart-related issues   |
    | 2             | Neurology       | Brain-related issues   |
    | 3             | Invalid ID      | Invalid description    |

  Scenario: Administrator Screens
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator accesses the System Administrator Screens
    Then the administrator can perform the following actions:
      | Action | Description |
      | Set-up Users/ Passwords | Create and manage user accounts |
      | Set-up Control File (for Pincode) | Configure pincode settings |
      | Create Appointment File | Create and manage appointment schedules |
      | View/ Print Invoice | View and print invoices |
      | Back-ups | Create backups of the System |
      | Archive Patient Profiles | Archive patient profiles |

  Scenario: User ID/ Password Maintenance
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to set up user IDs and passwords
    Then the user IDs and passwords are maintained in the System

  Scenario: Control File Configuration
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to set up the control file
    Then the control file is configured with the specified settings

  Scenario: Appointment File Creation
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to create an appointment file
    Then the appointment file is created in the System

  Scenario: Invoice Viewing and Printing
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to view and print an invoice
    Then the invoice is displayed and printed in the System

  Scenario: Backup Creation
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to create a backup
    Then the backup is created in the System

  Scenario: Patient Profile Archiving
    Given a valid administrator username and password
    When the administrator attempts to archive a patient profile
    Then the patient profile is archived in the System
```
